title: Meesho’s Next Monetisation Engines
script:
Meesho reported a quarterly net merchandise value of over twelve thousand crore rupees.
CEO Vidit Aatrey is shifting focus toward new monetisation engines.
The company now serves two hundred eighty-four million annual transacting users.
Meesho is now prioritising non-commerce revenue streams to reach profitability.
It is expanding services like logistics and financial solutions for sellers.
These services aim to diversify income beyond the core marketplace model.
Would you pay for premium visibility on a budget marketplace?
